notes.title: Patch is Out [v1.0.9]
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Just pushed another patch today, up to v1.0.9! Those on 4:3 monitors will appreciate it fixing the Suspect Log being cut off, and a minor occasional bug fixed too.

http://img.photobucket.com/albums/v474/Koobazaur/bug-squashing2_zpsueerwefd.jpg

Cheers!
- Jakub, Lead Dev
